background: Jim Willox is a Converse County commissioner, serving through the end of the current term in January 2027. He won the November 2022 general election, and the official commissioners page lists him as a member. Incoming commissioner Cody Torgerson takes office in January 2027. This local Profile covers his county-commission service; year-archive Officials Profiles were not changed.
